TEXT:
It's been a few days since the events in Atami. I've 
been invited to Ayase's place.

That's fine and all, but Ayase's behaving kind of 
strangely.

Well, maybe what happened at that inn had a 
greater effect on her than I'd thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I'm sorry. I know I called you here, and yet I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Nah, don't worry. Can't help it if you feel under the 
weather.

Honestly, she doesn't look very good. Maybe it's 
better if I come back another time.
Thinking that, I started to get up.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: P-Please wait!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I am truly sorry about what happened!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Acting like that in front of you... I'm so ashamed of 
myself.

Actually, that felt more like a reward than anything 
else. Though I can't really say that.
...But is that what's been on her mind all this time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I should be the one apologizing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Back then, if I'd only been able to notice that you 
were acting strangely, I could've stopped you.
I truly mean that, okay? I'm not lying.

I'd been so focused on my own thoughts that I 
didn't even think about her. That's why things went 
the way they did.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I guess I kind of lost my reasoning as well... I'm 
really sorry!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
You're not at fault, Onii-san! If I had just acted 
properly...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Besides... I'm always so serious... I don't even 
understand how I could let something like that 
happen...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I'm sorry. Both for this and for being so selfish on 
our usual dates.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I wish I can just lighten up and take things easy...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's all fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I mean, that's what makes you, you, Ayase.

Laughing, blushing and getting embarrassed, crying, 
being sad and getting jealous. It's all her.

She's cute either way... They're all Ayase's feelings. 
There's no need to deny any of that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's fine if you're serious. I still think that's when 
you're the cutest, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
And besides, I'm sorry too. I'm always making you 
mad...

Noticing how strange it was that we were both 
lowering our heads and reflecting on our actions, 
we laughed a little.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We've just been apologizing over and over again 
for a while now, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...That's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So then, I guess we're even.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That's... true.

Ayase let out a sigh of relief. And then she seemed 
to notice something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: No, it's just...

Ayase seemed to be contemplating something. ...Eh? 
What's going on here?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: D-Do guys... [font_size=33]like that kind of stuff?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=44]Huh?![/font_size]

W-Why are you asking that all of a sudden, 
Ayase-san?!

Not paying heed to my choking, Ayase was looking 
straight into my eyes. Her expression was the very 
image of seriousness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Look, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Y-Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I love you! I want to know anything and 
everything about you! [font_size=26]However, I don't 
want anyone else seeing you in a swimsuit![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
T-That's not true. I mean, guys are basically like 
that, but I'm a gentleman.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I... see.
